source_chart_summary: Figure 18 is a 100% stacked horizontal bar chart titled 'Digital misalignment is most prevalent in claims, quote and implementation processes.' with 5 legend series ('Already have and use', 'Already have but do not use', 'Do not have but want', 'Do not have and do not want', and 'Don't know') grouped across 4 sections ('Quote and implementation', 'Enrollment', 'Ongoing service', and 'Claims') and 19 total categories.
